edition.contentSummary: Youngpoong lists this as a standalone 204-page physical book and labels product code 9772635471005 as ISBN-13. The code fails ISBN-13 prefix rules and is omitted from the ISBN field; no independent serial-number assignment was verified. Youngpoong dates its listing 2019-08-08 and Kyobo lists 2019-08-12, while contemporary coverage describes March 2019 presales.
